name: GitHub PR Merge
description: List approved pull requests matching a label, verify their CI status, and merge them in batch.

max_prs.description: Maximum number of PRs to merge in a single run

label.description: Label that marks PRs as eligible for merging

steps.description: List open PRs with the specified label that have been approved
Verify that all required status checks are passing for each listed PR
Merge each approved PR that has passing status checks

constraints: Only merge PRs that have at least one approving review
Block merge if any required status check is failing or pending
Limit the number of PRs merged per run to the max_prs input
invariants: No PR without an approving review is ever merged
No PR with failing required checks is ever merged
The total number of merged PRs never exceeds max_prs
